description: Get the 7-day NWS forecast (12-hour day/night periods) for a US lat/lon OR a named NWS gridpoint such as "EWX/161,98". Returns named periods (e.g., "Tonight", "Wednesday") with high/low temperature, wind, and a short text forecast. US locations only.

gridpoint.description: NWS gridpoint instead of lat/lon, written office/x,y exactly as the forecast office publishes it, e.g. "EWX/161,98" (forecast office EWX, grid x 161, grid y 98). Use this when the question names a gridpoint; lat/lon are then not needed.

latitude.description: US latitude (omit when a gridpoint is given)

longitude.description: US longitude (omit when a gridpoint is given)

office.description: Forecast office id (3 letters, e.g. "EWX"). Alternative to `gridpoint`; pass with grid_x and grid_y.

name: nws_get_forecast

latitude.description: Input latitude (absent when the forecast was requested by gridpoint)

longitude.description: Input longitude (absent when the forecast was requested by gridpoint)

title: Nws Get Forecast
